items.title: Official @cockroachjantaparty post-burst after the morning re-detention
items.summary: Three never-reported official-handle posts surfaced in this run's IG-CLI pull, all tied to the already-alerted Tuesday-morning gate-climb re-detention of Das/Ranka/Shinde: (1) image post 'No one can stop us from waving the Tiranga at Jantar Mantar!' (~60K likes); (2) reel 'We are here to Reclaim our rights! Gyanesh Kumar must Go!' (~136K likes); (3) reel 'You cannot denotify the resistance!' (~67K likes). Missed by the 06:09Z run (its CLI leg returned no output). Defiance restatement; no new facts beyond the already-alerted reclaim/re-detention arc. No second outlet covers these specific posts -> single-sourced.
